title: ID0457868-DC/Si-D/IT- [Y2 / S7 313806942001] Charger error
description:
Reported behavior/issue: The charger 313806942001 is not working since two days.
Solution: Communication failure of KF1 bus adapter with LOGO and Switch XF1.

additional_info.body:
Hello,
the charger 313806942001 is not working since two days. Is it possible to check?
Thank you in advance.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0457868-DC/Si-D/IT- [Y2 / S7 313806942001] Charger error CRM:03044000043
additional_info.body:
Buongiorno colleghi,
I am writing you in regards of ticket
ID0457868
for charger
Y2/S7 313806942001
at Monte Alto Nord.
Yesterday I supported Giuseppe onsite to verify the status of the charger. Despite the initial pre-analysis, the LOGO KF10 was powered on, as well as TB18.
What was missing was the LAN communication between KF10 and PLC KF1. Reconnection and replacement of the ETH cable did not bring any result.
It was noticed, however, that on the ET200SP Bus Adapter of KF1, where the LAN connection with LOGO is in place, also the LAN connection between KF1 and the switch XF1 was not established. This was visible by the two small LEDs on the Bus Adapter of KF1, LEDs LK1 and LK2, which were both off.
By switching off the charger, removing the Bus adapter from KF1 and restoring the connections, the charger booted up normally and error flag "LOGO tripped" did not appear since.
Therefore, I assume the error was caused by a failure of the BUS adapter of KF1, which interrupted the communication towards KF10 and XF1.
Since the error since to be solved, I would proceed to close this ticket. If the error appears again, I would recommend to go onsite and replace the Bus Adapter of the KF1. It is available as spare part from the spare part list:
Thank you!
With kind regards,
